For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Extract a column from a 2D matrix.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> matrix get-col {flags} (index)```

## Parameters

 -  `index`: The column index to extract (0-based).


## Input/output types:

| input  | output      |
| ------ | ----------- |
| matrix | list&lt;float&gt; |
## Examples

Get the first column of a 2x3 matrix
```nu
> matrix zeros 2 3 | matrix set-col 0 [1.0 2.0] | matrix get-col 0 | to nuon
[1.0, 2.0]
```

Get the second column of a 2x2 identity matrix
```nu
> matrix identity 2 | matrix get-col 1 | to nuon
[0.0, 1.0]
```
